defect.cause: Canonical updateEntity calls Model:PivotTo for every alive model on each simulation step even when coordinates are unchanged. Anchored units in combat remain stationary for many ticks, causing redundant transform writes.
defect.reproduction: Execute the complete canonical server through tests/roblox_server_harness.lua. In a 3-stud combat encounter with both cooldowns set high, after initial placement the old server increments _pivotCount for both stationary models every Heartbeat. The new regression checks repeated idle ticks and a pinned old whole-server negative control when available.

fix: Track each entity's last rendered x/z from its initial model placement. Only call Model:PivotTo when actual position changes, then update rendered coordinates. Preserve immediate damage bar updates and moving-unit transform updates.
character_impact: PON, GUARDON, TANKURU and JUNK unit attributes, economy, attack cadence and visuals unchanged; only identical stationary model transforms are skipped.

tests.negative_control: Pinned old whole-server fixture when available

evidence.main_qa_note: Both jobs succeeded on merge source 82fed9a; 1b0751 is verified status-only descendant.

next_action: Create draft PR and require exact-head offline plus compile_hold success; independent REVIEWER alone may integrate. Do not claim device frame-time improvement without hardware measurement.
